dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: Hmm... Wanna join me in some choir practice?

choices.text: Sounds like something I'd be good at!

response.speaker: Dahlia
response.text: Just so you know, in choir singing, there's no "I," only "we." The goal is perfect harmony, like how the sounds of the world all blend seamlessly into the wind.

response.speaker: Dahlia
response.text: Still, self-confidence is important. Newcomers to the choir are often too shy or afraid to sing.

response.speaker: Dahlia
response.text: Why don't we do some vocal warm-ups? Here, like so...

response.speaker: Dahlia
response.text: I did give it some serious thought, but ended up deciding against it.

response.speaker: Dahlia
response.text: Idols have to be able to greet their fans with energy and enthusiasm. Being kind by nature, Barbara is always happy to oblige...

response.speaker: Dahlia
response.text: But I struggle to spend time with people I find boring, which just so happens to be most of them...

response.speaker: Dahlia
response.text: And when it comes to those who bore me, all I can muster up is the bare-bones minimum.

response.speaker: Dahlia
response.text: So, I prefer to stay on the sidelines, observing how Barbara lives up to people's expectations of an idol.

response.speaker: Dahlia
response.text: I won't lie — I find that far more satisfying than being an idol myself.

response.speaker: Dahlia
response.text: Wait, do YOU want to be an idol? We still don't have an idol from the Knights just yet! The Honorary Knight of Mondstadt, now the first Knight-Idol of the land... Just thinking about it is making me giddy!

response.speaker: Dahlia
response.text: Just leave the voice lessons to me. You'll be ready to make your debut in no time!

response.speaker: Dahlia
response.text: Aww, what's the harm in trying? Come on, just follow my lead...

choices.text: Ever thought about making your own debut as an idol?
What if I can't carry a tune?

response.speaker: Dahlia
response.text: None of our hymns are technically difficult. I'm sure you'll be able to find your voice as long as you put some genuine emotion into it.
